ShortDescription.Value: Hide different Ui elements, when not hovering over it. Now Includes Show Text Trend by DanielVNZ and New Tooltips for Money and Population

Publish.LongDescription:
Beyond Numbers hides the population number on the city toolbar unless the player hovers over it (Need to be activated in Settings). It also hides the demand bars and Time information in a similar manner (can be activated in the settings). This helps reduce stress when building a detailed city, as the raw numbers are only shown when you actually want to see them.
Features: Everything in this Mod can be Activated/Deactivated in the Settings - Hide Population Number: The population count is not hidden by default. - Hide Demand Bars: Optionally hide the demand bars (Residential, Commercial, Industrial) until hovered. - Hide Time of day: Optinal you can Hide these to reduce stress when building detail as it doesnt show how long you have been detailing in the current game Session. - Hide Current Year: Optinal you can Hide these to reduce stress when building detail as it doesnt show how long you have been detailing in the current game Session. - Population Trend Overlay: A subtle balloon indicator shows whether your population is growing or shrinking — without showing the exact number. - Population Trend Tooltip: Hovering over the population number shows a tooltip with the monthly trend of your city’s population. - Money Trend Overlay: A similar overlay shows the trend of your city’s budget over time, so you stay informed without feeling pressured. - Money Trend Tooltip: Hovering over the money icon shows a tooltip with the monthly trend of your city’s budget. - Show Text Trends integration: The functionality of the “Show Text Trends” mod is now built directly into Beyond Numbers, combining both mods into one. - Fully configurable: All overlays and hiding behaviors can be toggled independently in the mod settings. Special Thanks to DanielVNZ for who originally created the “Show Text Trends” mod, which has now been merged into Beyond Numbers.
If you have any feedback or suggestions, please let me know in the forum thread or on the Discord modding server: https://discord.gg/HTav7ARPs2
The Thumbnail is based on the Thumbnail Style by Luca (The mod Author of Platter). I had a chat with Luca and got his permission to use the Thumbnail Style for Beyond Numbers. Big thanks to Honu/River-mochi for the tip on how to rebuild the mod's interface so it works more smoothly with the game's UI.

ChangeLog.Value:
- New: Detailed Population Tooltip Hovering over the population now shows a full breakdown: monthly trend, population, birth rate, death rate, citizens moved in and away, jobs, employed citizens, unemployment, homeless citizens and homeless rate. Every line can be switched on or off in the settings. A master switch turns the whole tooltip on or off at once. The monthly trend in the tooltip can be turned on or off separately from the trend shown in the toolbar.
City Watchdog compatibility: Beyond Numbers now detects City Watchdog. Its own trend displays and tooltips switch off automatically so nothing is shown twice, and settings that don't apply are hidden.
Improvements: Rebuilt the mod's interface so it works more smoothly with the game's UI. Thanks to Honu/River-mochi for the tip! ´Hide Time´now also hides the AM/PM indicator. German translation for all new settings. New Mod Pictures for better showing of the mod's features in the screenshots.
Bug fixes Fixed settings sometimes not being saved between game sessions. Fixed tooltips still showing extra information when City Watchdog was installed. Fixed the UI integration with a more DOM free aproach
